Docs.summary: Defines channels for I/O operations, including file and socket channels, and selectors for multiplexed non-blocking I/O.

remarks.para: Channels read bytes into buffers and write bytes from buffers. Scattering reads use a sequence of destination buffers; gathering writes use a sequence of source buffers. File channels also support file positions, locks, memory mapping, and transfers between channels. Selectors monitor registered channels for non-blocking I/O readiness.

The .NET methods with an Async suffix on synchronous channel classes, and the channel extension methods, run the matching synchronous operation with System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run. They retain that operation's blocking-mode behavior and result. These wrappers are separate from the Java asynchronous file and socket channel APIs.
See the Android channel package documentation and the .NET binding generator's method task wrappers and extension task wrappers.
